title: 卑尔维斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 蝠鲼般的身躯展开紫色翼鳍，上方保留小巧的带冠人形头部。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Bel'Veth is a colossal manta-like Void empress with sweeping purple wing-fins, a long tapering tail, pale gold accents, and a small crowned humanoid-looking head above the broad ray body. Preserve the distinctive ray anatomy and elegant fin geometry, never substituting a human body. Keep the face composed and the underside closed, without exposed maw, frightening teeth, injury, or realistic horror.
art_direction.scene: A complete NONHUMAN MANTA RAY seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter viewpoint. The principal mass is a BROAD FLAT DIAMOND-SHAPED RAY DISC, much wider than it is deep, occupying the central two thirds of the square. Sweeping triangular purple wing-fins are continuous extensions of that wide flattened fish body, NOT wings attached to human shoulders. A SMALL crowned humanoid-looking lure head rises only a short distance above the FRONT EDGE of the ray disc; the head is tiny compared with the broad body. One long narrow tapering ray tail extends from the REAR MIDLINE and curls gently into open paper. NO human torso, bust, waist, hips, arms, hands, legs, dress, gown or skirt. Keep the whole ray outline and every fin tip inside the square. Calm dignified suspension above one pale rock cue, no attacks or exposed underside. Bright iris purple, lilac, clear turquoise reflections and pale gold edge details, lively colored-pencil hatching on luminous paper.
art_direction.palette: royal purple, plum shadow, gold, pale lilac; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
